summary.text: Carmen Bucco is the Republican nominee for New Jersey's 10th Congressional District. He owns Bucco Couture, a tailoring business, and says he grew up in the foster care system. He was the Republican nominee for NJ-10 in 2024 and ran unsuccessfully for New Jersey State Senate District 20 in 2023 and General Assembly District 20 in 2025. His campaign website says he is running to put people first and focus on stopping corruption.

paragraphs.text: Born in New Jersey and graduated from Nutley High School in 1990.
According to his campaign website, he grew up in the foster care system and lived on the streets at times.
Works as a tailor and owns Bucco Couture, a tailoring business; his campaign website calls it a small business.
His campaign website says he has a foundation, Bucco's Rising Stars, that supports children.
Ran unsuccessfully as the Republican candidate for New Jersey State Senate District 20 in 2023, losing to incumbent Joseph Cryan.
Won the Republican nomination for NJ-10 and lost both the September 2024 special election and the November 2024 general election to LaMonica McIver.

Won the June 2025 Republican primary for New Jersey General Assembly District 20 with 95.2% of the vote and finished third in the November general election with 14.3%, behind Democrats Annette Quijano and Ed Rodriguez.
Won the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for NJ-10 unopposed.
